signIn.title: Sign in to {app}
signIn.description: You sign in in your browser. {app} never sees your password.
signIn.waiting: Waiting for the browser… Finish signing in there.
signIn.failed: Sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
signIn.timeout: Sign-in timed out. Please try again.
signIn.unavailable: Sign-in is not available in this build.
signIn.callbackBody: You can close this tab and return to {app}.

missing.title: Your plan does not include {app}
missing.description: Upgrade in your browser, then come back — {app} checks again automatically.

deviceLimit.title: Device limit reached
deviceLimit.description: Your account is signed in on {count} of {limit} devices. Remove one in your browser to use this one.

upgrade.title: This version needs an upgrade
upgrade.description: Your licence covers version {major}. Upgrade your licence to use this version.

unreachable.title: Cannot reach {app}
unreachable.description: Check your internet connection. Without a connection, {app} works offline for a limited time after you have signed in once.

offlineBanner: Offline — your access is valid until {date}.
